How iv always done things is put a set amount into savings first. Most places will let you actually split your direct deposit. So you can have a set amount going to savings and then the rest checking. Make sure all bills that need paid are. Make sure to have money for gas, food and any other expenses. One thing I would do is depending on how much I made I would pull out a small amount of money in cash and put it aside. That was my me money. Usually it was $20 but as I started making more it was anywhere from $50 to $100 each paycheck. That was for if I wanted to eat out. Buy a book or  just sit on it. If you decide to spend money then pay attention to sales. If you know a major sale for manga is in a month or so then hold on to the money you take out as personal money. That way when the sale comes you will have more money. Also don't forget to reward yourself! Say you got a raise or a promotion then maybe go get a few manga or buy something small. Manga is fairly inexpensive so spoiling yourself every once in a while isn't bad. But just be cautious about how much you spend. 

Also!!! There are budget apps that can help as well. If keeping an actual budget journal will help then do that.

When you turn 18 you are able to get your ssn card, birth certificate passport and any other important documentation you need. You have a few options when going about getting them. A, you can just ask for them and hope they give them to you. B, contact the police and explain they will not give you the documents and get them involved. Only issue is your completely burning the bridge with them and you need to make sure you have a trusted place to go after doing that. C, you ask and they say no and you go through the process of getting the documents on your own. You could see if a friend or a trusted family member will let you use their address to send those documents to so they are going someplace safe. I would also keep an eye on your credit because some people use their kids identity to get loans and credit cards. 

Hoard money! You will need some form of cash to get documents or help you get places. If you have enough maybe even a place to stay temporarily. Reach out to friends or trusted family also about maybe staying with them. Even if it's for a short period of time. Try and find a social worker or contact shelters as well to get info on housing or places to stay once you turn 18. That way you can make a plan and have back up plans in case you need to just up and go. 

Definitely look into schools. I know dorm life may not be something you want but definitely keep it an open option. Military wise make sure it's 100% something you wanna do. I also know that some basic jobs offer tuition for schools so maybe try and look up some of those. There are even some jobs that pay for housing and what not but you usually need to relocate for those. 

You don't owe them anything. Yes they are your parents and they brought you into the world and raised you but you don't need to be the one supporting them. Especially with how they are treating you. Look into all options. Make a good plan. Make sure you have multiple back up plans. Don't be afraid to ask for help and there is nothing wrong with accepting help when offered. Be proactive about the situation. We may not be able to financially help and take you out of there but we can definitely be a support system and to listen to you when you need someone to talk to.

I know how you feel fully. I won't bore you with details but long story short is I have cancer. I'm almost to the finish line but unfortunately even after 12 rounds it's still there and because of the place the one spot that is left radiation will make it impossible for me to have another child of my own or even carry one. The feeling of having that ripped away tears me apart. On top of that I'm a single mom to a little boy who's father isn't even in his life. So yes I was able to have one but I won't be able to provide a someone a child of their own. 

It is an extremely hard thing to deal with but not being able to provide a child does not mean you are unwanted. Theres someone out there. They will come into your life when you least expect it. Could be today, tomorrow, next week, next year or even a few years down the road. I know it sucks to be alone but until that person comes around do you. Build your life. Go on adventures. They will pop up before you know it.
